name: Spatio-temporal Gaussian Tracking
definition: A method to model surface dynamics in surgical scenes by tracking the attribute shift of each Gaussian at time t using a deformation field D(µ, t), allowing rendering of deformed Gaussians Gt.
summary: Spatio-temporal Gaussian Tracking models surface dynamics by tracking Gaussian attribute shifts via a lightweight, decomposed encoding voxel and small MLPs, prioritizing real-time inference speed over large neural networks.
